      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements delayed scheduling and dispatch of private transaction broadcasts in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Mitigates time-correlation-based tracking of transaction origins by queuing and jittering broadcasts through outbound privacy networks. The problem is a recognized privacy concern, though the implementation is currently author-driven and holds delayed transactions strictly in memory."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies sendrawtransaction RPC argument parsing and dispatch in src/rpc/mempool.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds an optional delay_for parameter to sendrawtransaction. New RPC arguments lacking cited demand from external downstream consumers rank low in RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
